summary: End-to-end verification after FeatureOverlay removal. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass, including new coverage for attendance record + student summary, PJJ create, real .xlsx export (validated as ZIP with column headers), single-active-period constraint, notification mark-read, and student 403 boundaries across admin + teacher endpoints. Frontend: FeatureOverlay.js confirmed deleted and not referenced from index.js or bundle. All previously flagged flows now work via real React state: teacher-success-message + grade-feedback render after grading, .xlsx download fires, student assignment-persistent-status renders from submissions state, notification mark-read reduces unread count from 4->3, attendance-success-message and pjj-success-message both render. Student quiz submit/score, download materials, PJJ join, attendance percent all functional. Admin can activate periods (single-active enforced backend-side).

ui_bugs.issue: Row main title renders 'undefined · undefined' because periods have no name/title/teacher fields; the fallback expression x.name || x.title || `${x.teacher} · ${x.class_name}` never falls through to year/semester. Only the sublabel shows the correct '2026/2027 · Ganjil'. Recommend adding `${x.year} · ${x.semester}` to the fallback chain for periods.

Persistent status shows only 'Submitted · <file> · Submitted' after a fresh grade because the student view auto-selects data.tasks?.[0], which is the seeded assignment, not the newly-graded TEST assignment. If the selected assignment matches, Final score/Feedback render correctly; if the student clicks another task in the list there is no way to change 'selected'. Consider making each task row selectable so the status card follows the tapped assignment.

issues: React dev warning: <span> injected inside <option> causes 'In HTML, %s cannot be a child of' hydration warning. Source is likely dev-time instrumentation on option children (`{String.fromCharCode(65+j)} · {o}` split); harmless in production but noisy in devtools.

action_items: Fix AdminList period title fallback to include `${x.year} · ${x.semester}` so Academic periods stop rendering 'undefined · undefined'.
Optional: allow the student Assignments page to change the selected task so assignment-persistent-status can reflect the just-graded submission for any assignment, not only tasks[0].
critical_code_review_comments: AdminList row title expression `x.name || x.title || `${x.teacher} · ${x.class_name}`` produces 'undefined · undefined' for periods and should have a period-specific branch.
App.js is 1067 lines with Admin/Teacher/Student workspaces and modals all in one file; consider splitting by role for maintainability (>700 line guideline).
TeacherGradeReports.grade() defaults feedback to a hardcoded encouragement string when empty — this silently overwrites the teacher's intent-to-blank feedback; consider allowing empty feedback.

Student StudentAssignments uses local mySubs state seeded from data.submissions, but refresh() reloads dashboard; there is a brief window where the recently-submitted row could be duplicated if the server returns a different id — currently mitigated by assignment_id filter but relies on that guarantee.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; one Admin display bug remains)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed quiz, assignment, attendance session, PJJ session, and Academic periods through the API/UI flows. Did not modify seeded production rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FeatureOverlay is fully gone; do NOT reintroduce DOM MutationObserver hacks. All new backend endpoints (POST /teacher/attendance, POST /teacher/pjj, GET /teacher/grades/export) have coverage in test_iteration5_features.py. Only outstanding UI defect is the AdminList period title fallback showing 'undefined · undefined'. Note: pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope; run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Grading formula is 0.6*quiz + 0.4*assignment (verified: 100 quiz + 85 assignment = 94 final).
rca of the issue: N/A — previously reported iteration_4 issues (grade success rendering, assignment persistent status) are fixed via proper React state (savedFeedback + message in TeacherGradeReports; mySubs in StudentAssignments). No MutationObserver code remains.
